name: mellow fellow
source:
The main character, Hinakawa Touko (name can be changed), is an ordinary high school girl who lacks a bit of feminine charm.
She enjoys her high school life with her beautiful childhood friend, Moriya Hikari.

But recently, Hikari has been telling Toruko that she should be more modest. The reason for this is a new classmate, the handsome Matsunami Kirito. Since Touko seems to be interested in him, Hikari suggested for her beloved friend to try and act more feminine.

Should she take Hikari's advice and change? Should she stay the same and continue her insensitive behaviour? The future of Touko's love is in your hands...

[translated from the [url=https://ponkotsu.onasake.com/mellow/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
主人公雏川透子（姓名可更改）是个普通的高中女生，只是不太懂得展现女性魅力。
她和美丽的青梅竹马守谷光一起，享受着高中生活。

然而最近，光总劝透子要更有女人味。原因是班上新来了一位帅气的同学松浪雾人。光觉得透子似乎对他有意，便建议自己最要好的朋友试着表现得更有女人味。

她该听从光的建议，改变自己吗？还是保持原样，继续我行我素？透子的恋爱将走向何方，就由你来决定……

[译自[url=https://ponkotsu.onasake.com/mellow/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
